title: GovernedAction/v1 Predicate
description: Predicate for an in-toto Statement (ITE-6) recording ONE governed action: what an AI agent was authorized to do, what it actually did, and whether the required evidence exists. Envelope: https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1 with payloadType application/vnd.in-toto+json. This predicate is NOT a zero-knowledge proof and NOT a proof of computation; it is a signed, tamper-evident audit record of a governance decision. Fail-closed laws: (1) missing evidence => completeness INCOMPLETE, and a non-COMPLETE receipt never yields PASS; (2) principal.is_service_account is const false — EU AI Act Article 12(3)(d) style verification of a consequential action requires a natural person principal, and a service account MUST NOT claim to be one; (3) verdict PASS requires ntp_synced true AND an RFC 3161 timestamp token (anti-backdating); (4) any redaction MUST carry salted-hash redaction_commitments so an auditor can detect that redaction did not remove exculpatory evidence.

type.description: Namespaced action type, e.g. estate.audit.github, agent.change_management.patch_deploy

target.description: Resource the action acted on, if any

idempotency_key.description: Stable key proving no duplicate execution on crash recovery

is_service_account.description: Structurally unviolatable at the schema layer for the human-principal profile: a consequential governed action verified under Article 12 requires an identified natural person. Service-account-executed actions use the service_account profile, which cannot claim human verification.

auth_token_digest.description: sha256 of the credential used, so a human claim bearing a service token is detectable

evaluated_before_execution.description: Pre-execution gating. Post-hoc logging of an already-executed action is not a governed action.

policy_ref.description: Digest or URI of the policy revision evaluated

side_effect_class.description: Four classes, never collapsed. IRREVERSIBLE and EXTERNALLY_VISIBLE always require human_approval when outcome is ALLOW.

completeness.description: Derived, never asserted: INCOMPLETE if any obligation is unsatisfied. A verifier MUST NOT output PASS when completeness is INCOMPLETE.

rfc3161_token.description: Base64 RFC 3161 time-stamp token over the receipt digest. Required for PASS.

redaction_commitments.description: One salted hash commitment per redacted field: sha256(salt || field_path || original_value). Lets an auditor confirm redaction removed only what it claims — exculpatory evidence cannot be silently deleted.

deployment_revision.description: The revision actually executed. Runtime stage=RUNNING is NEVER accepted as evidence of this field.

source_revision.description: The revision reviewed. Divergence from deployment_revision is a first-class finding.

limitations.description: Honest scope limits of this record. Empty limitations on a consequential action is a smell, not a strength.
